title: The Almost-Closed Car Door
spec: Close the car door and start getting comfortable. The dashboard announces “Door open.” Open it again and close it harder.

title: The Flush That Goes Up
spec: Flush the toilet. Instead of draining, the water slowly rises toward the rim. You watch it climb, waiting for it to finally go down.

title: One HP Too Many
spec: Get an enemy down to exactly one health point. Your next attack is almost ready—but the enemy lands its final hit first.

title: The Wrong Quest Reward
spec: Finish a long quest and choose your reward. Just after confirming, realize you selected the wrong sword. The reward window closes permanently.

title: Ten Monsters, One Hundred Players
spec: Accept a quest to defeat ten monsters. Arrive at the quest area and find a crowd surrounding every spawn point. Your counter remains at 0/10.

title: Someone Got There First
spec: Run toward the last piece of quest firewood. Just before your collection bar finishes, another player picks it up and it disappears.

title: Second Place at the Finish Line
spec: Lead the entire race. With the finish line directly ahead, another car slips past and wins by a few centimeters.

title: The Mystery Smoke Alarm
spec: Replace the battery in a chirping smoke alarm. Enjoy a moment of silence—then hear another chirp coming from the locked room next door.

title: The Merge Conflict Surprise
spec: Finish a major coding task and try to push it. The push is rejected. Pull the latest changes and discover merge conflicts throughout your carefully finished work.

title: The Bedtime Mosquito
spec: Get comfortable, turn off the light, and close your eyes. A mosquito starts whining beside your ear. Turn the light on, and it vanishes.

title: The Untouchable Fly
spec: Follow a fly across the ceiling and prepare the perfect swat. It escapes at the last moment and lands directly on your nose.

title: The Wasp Beside the Open Door
spec: Open the door wide to let a wasp out. It repeatedly bumps into the closed glass panel immediately beside the enormous opening.

title: The Shopping Mall Interception
spec: Walk through a shopping mall. A fundraiser steps into your path with a friendly greeting. Sidestep them and immediately encounter another fundraiser.

title: The Sales Call Timing
spec: Finally sit down to relax. Your phone rings with a sales call. End the conversation, put the phone down, and another unknown number starts calling.

title: Roadworks on Every Route
spec: Follow a diversion around roadworks. Turn onto the alternative route and find another road closure. The next detour leads to temporary traffic lights.

title: One Light That Doesn’t Match
spec: Switch on a row of identical lamps. All shine bright white except one noticeably dim, yellow bulb. Once you notice it, your eyes keep returning to it.

title: The Stone in Your Shoe
spec: Feel a tiny stone under your foot. Remove the shoe and shake it thoroughly. Put it back on, take three steps, and feel the stone again.

title: The Song on Every Station
spec: Change the radio station to escape an irritating song. The next station is playing it too. Switch again and land on the chorus.

title: The Safety Cap That Just Spins
spec: Twist a bottle cap, but it only clicks and spins. Notice the tiny “Push down and turn” instruction. Your first attempt still fails to catch.

title: The Wobbly Table
spec: Set a drink on the table and rest your arm beside it. The table rocks. Stabilize one corner, and the opposite corner starts moving instead.

title: The Squeaky Chair
spec: Sit down in a quiet room. The chair squeaks whenever you shift your weight. Try to find a comfortable position that makes no noise.

title: Straight Into the Sun
spec: Turn a corner and face the low sun directly. Search your pockets for sunglasses and find only their empty case.

title: The Unreachable Itch
spec: An itch appears in the exact middle of your back. Reach over your shoulder, then around your waist. Your fingertips stop just short every time.

title: The Renovation Holiday
spec: Begin your holiday and settle in for a peaceful morning. Drilling starts next door at eight. The clock advances through eight hours of renovation noise.

title: Waiting for Cold Water
spec: Turn the tap to its coldest setting and fill a glass. The water is lukewarm. Empty it, wait, and try again. Still lukewarm.

title: The Stolen Parking Space
spec: Circle a full car park until you finally spot someone leaving. Approach the empty space, and another driver slips into it just before you.

title: The Festival Toilet Queue
spec: Join a long toilet queue. After slowly reaching the corner, discover that the line continues around it and stretches much farther than you thought.

title: The Slightly Crooked Apartment
spec: Get the keys to your new apartment. Put a marble on the floor and watch it roll steadily into a corner. Check another room. Same result.

title: Almost the Same Outfit
spec: Carefully choose an outfit for an event. Arrive and find another guest wearing almost exactly the same thing. You end up standing together in the photo.

title: Only the Black Sweets Left
spec: Share a bag of sweets with a friend. Reach for your favorite color, but they take the last one. Only the black sweets remain.

title: The Last Fish Finger
spec: Queue at the cafeteria for fish fingers. The person ahead takes the last ones. You reach the serving tray just as it is removed.

title: The Best Clothes, Immediately Stained
spec: Put on your finest outfit and admire it in the mirror. Pick up a drink before leaving and spill a small, very visible splash down the front.

title: Rush to Wait
spec: Hurry to a medical appointment and arrive just in time. Sit down in the waiting room. The clock advances forty minutes while your name remains uncalled.

title: Three Hours at the Gate
spec: Rush through the airport and finally reach your gate. Nobody is there. Check your boarding pass and discover that boarding starts in three hours.

title: The One-Treatment Military Clinic
spec: Choose a complaint at the military clinic. Whatever option you select, the medic hands over the same basic painkillers and points you back toward duty.

title: The Keyboard Consultation
spec: Start explaining your symptoms. The doctor keeps typing without looking up. You pause, wondering whether they are listening. The typing continues.

title: The Disruptive Seatmate
spec: Find a seat on the metro and settle in. The intoxicated passenger beside you starts talking loudly, leaning into your space, and repeatedly bumping your arm.

title: The Ticket App at the Bus Door
spec: Reach the front of the boarding queue and realize you still need a ticket. Open the app. A loading spinner turns while the driver and everyone behind you wait.

title: One Minute Early
spec: Reach the bus stop a minute before the scheduled departure. Watch your bus disappear down the road. The display changes to “Next bus: 20 min.”

title: The Bus That Stops Everywhere
spec: Board a bus when you are already in a hurry. Someone requests every stop. Every traffic light turns red. A delivery vehicle then blocks the next street.

title: The Actor on Every Channel
spec: Change channels to watch something different. The same actor appears in a drama, a detective series, and then the next advertisement.

title: Advertisements Everywhere
spec: Your program cuts to advertisements. Change channels and find more advertisements. Keep switching until you return to the original channel—still on advertisements.

title: You’ve Already Seen This Episode
spec: Finally find a promising program. A familiar scene appears. You predict the next line perfectly and realize it is the same repeat you watched recently.

title: That Catchphrase Again
spec: Hear an advertising slogan you are tired of. Switch to another program. During its next break, the same slogan returns in a slightly different advertisement.

title: The Recorded Sports Overrun
spec: Open the film you scheduled your recorder to save. It contains a sports broadcast that ran late. Skip forward until the recording ends before the film begins.

title: The Overwritten Video Tape
spec: Insert a tape labeled with your favorite film. Press Play and discover that somebody recorded an entirely different program over it.

title: Ten Minutes Before the Ending
spec: Reach the final ten minutes of a film. Your eyelids keep closing. Fight to stay awake, then open your eyes to the end credits.

title: The Sudden Disconnect
spec: Play normally with no warning signs. Everything freezes mid-action. A moment later, “Connection lost” appears and you are returned to the menu.

title: The Frozen Water Pipes
spec: Come home thirsty and place a glass beneath the tap. Turn it on. One drop falls, followed by nothing. The pipes are frozen.

title: The Expired Certificate
spec: Open the website you maintain, expecting its normal homepage. A security warning fills the screen instead. The certificate expired today.

title: The Tape Edge Hunt
spec: Rotate a roll of transparent tape until you find the edge. Lift it carefully, and only a narrow strip peels away. The rest stays stuck to the roll.

title: The Keyring Lottery
spec: Try several almost identical keys in a lock. None turns. The correct key is the final one, hiding behind the keys you already tried.

title: The Shoelace That Won’t Stay Tied
spec: Tie your shoelaces neatly and start walking. After a few steps, one bow comes undone and the loose lace drags along the ground.

title: The Expanding Fingerprint
spec: Notice a fingerprint on your glasses and wipe it with a cloth. The small mark spreads into a greasy haze across the entire lens.

title: The Door Handle Hook
spec: Walk through a doorway carrying a shoulder bag. Its strap catches on the handle, abruptly pulling you backward just as you think you are through.

title: The Resealable Bag That Won’t Seal
spec: Press along a bag’s resealable strip from one end to the other. Reach the end and discover that the first half has already popped open.

title: Caps Lock at Login
spec: Carefully type a long password into a hidden field. “Incorrect password.” Reveal the characters and discover that Caps Lock has reversed every letter’s case.

title: The Inside-Out Umbrella
spec: Open your umbrella as the rain gets heavier. A gust flips it inside out. Restore its shape, and the next gust immediately folds it backward again.

title: The Freshly Washed Car
spec: Finish washing your car and polish away the final water spot. Step back to admire it. A bird leaves a fresh splat in the middle of the windshield.

title: The Biscuit in the Tea
spec: Dip a biscuit into your tea. As you lift it toward your mouth, the softened half breaks off and sinks beneath the surface.

title: The Remote Just Out of Reach
spec: Find the missing remote behind the sofa. Reach down and touch it with your fingertips. Your attempt to grab it pushes it farther underneath.

title: The Blanket That’s Slightly Too Short
spec: Pull a blanket over your shoulders, exposing your feet. Cover your feet, and your shoulders become cold. Keep adjusting without finding a position that covers both.

title: The Final Screw
spec: Assemble some furniture and tighten the final screw. The screwdriver slips, damaging the screw head. Every further attempt slips out of the same shallow groove.

title: The Sock Outside the Wash
spec: Load the washing machine, close the door, and start the cycle. The door locks. Look down and spot one forgotten sock beside your foot.

title: The Shopping Cart’s Bad Wheel
spec: Take a shopping cart and push it straight ahead. One wheel rattles and pulls sideways. Correct its direction, and it immediately drifts toward the shelf again.

title: The Pen That Only Works on Scrap Paper
spec: Try to write on a card, but the pen produces nothing. Scribble on scrap paper and it works perfectly. Return to the card, and the ink stops again.
